// block: SINA_POS | language: SCL
FUNCTION_BLOCK "SINA_POS"

VAR_INPUT
   ModePos : Int NonRetain;
   EnableAxis : Bool NonRetain;
   CancelTraversing : Bool NonRetain;
   IntermediateStop : Bool NonRetain;
   Positive : Bool NonRetain;
   Negative : Bool NonRetain;
   Jog1 : Bool NonRetain;
   Jog2 : Bool NonRetain;
   FlyRef : Bool NonRetain;
   AckError : Bool NonRetain;
   ExecuteMode : Bool NonRetain;
   Position : DInt NonRetain;
   Velocity : DInt NonRetain;
   OverV : Int NonRetain;
   OverAcc : Int NonRetain;
   OverDec : Int NonRetain;
   ConfigEPos : DWord NonRetain;
   HWIDSTW : HW_IO NonRetain;
   HWIDZSW : HW_IO NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
   AxisEnabled : Bool NonRetain;
   AxisPosOk : Bool NonRetain;
   AxisSpFixed : Bool NonRetain;
   AxisRef : Bool NonRetain;
   AxisWarn : Bool NonRetain;
   AxisError : Bool NonRetain;
   Lockout : Bool NonRetain;
   ActVelocity : DInt NonRetain;
   ActPosition : DInt NonRetain;
   ActMode : Int NonRetain;
   EPosZSW1 : Word NonRetain;
   EPosZSW2 : Word NonRetain;
   ActWarn : Word NonRetain;
   ActFault : Word NonRetain;
   Error : Bool NonRetain;
   Status : Word NonRetain;
   DiagID : Word NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR
   sbOff1Edge : Bool NonRetain;
   sbOff1 : Bool NonRetain;
   sbExecuteEdge : Bool NonRetain;
   sbExecute : Bool NonRetain;
   sbRefTypEdge : Bool NonRetain;
   sbRefTyp : Bool NonRetain;
   sbMdiStart : Bool NonRetain;
   sbMdiStartEdge : Bool NonRetain;
   sbRefStart : Bool NonRetain;
   sbJogInc : Bool NonRetain;
   sbReady : Bool NonRetain;
   sbIOp : Bool NonRetain;
   sbAccel : Bool NonRetain;
   sbDecel : Bool NonRetain;
   sbAlarm : Bool NonRetain;
   sbFault : Bool NonRetain;
   sbFWD : Bool NonRetain;
   sbBWD : Bool NonRetain;
   sbBusy : Bool NonRetain;
   swStatus : Word NonRetain;
   swEPosZSW1 : Word NonRetain;
   swEPosZSW2 : Word NonRetain;
   siExecuteCyc : Int NonRetain;
   siRefTypCyc : Int NonRetain;
   siJogIncCyc : Int NonRetain;
   siMdiStartCyc : Int NonRetain;
   siRefActRetry : Int NonRetain;
   siModePos : Int NonRetain;
   siModePosMax : Int NonRetain;
   siCycWait : Int NonRetain;
   siRetryMax : Int NonRetain;
   sbModePos : Bool NonRetain;
   sxSendBuf : Struct NonRetain;
   sxRecvBuf : Struct NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_TEMP
   piRetSFC : Int;
   piCount : Int;
   swSendBuf : Array[0..11] of Word;
   swRecvBuf : Array[0..11] of Word;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

// ---- implementation ----
// =============================================================================
// SIEMENS AG
// (c)Copyright 2019 All Rights Reserved
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Library: DriveLib
// Tested with: -
// Engineering: TIA Portal V15.1
// Restrictions: -
// Requirements: S7-1200 / S7-1500
// Functionality: cyclic communication between a SINAMICS (Basic positioner)and a PLC
// If in HWConfig Std.TLG 111 is projected 12 PZD-words are exchanged
// in every bus cycle.
// The parametrisation of these words is described in the manual of the
// SINAMICS
// =============================================================================

// Betriebsart ermitteln
IF ModePos > siModePosMax THEN
  
  sbModePos := FALSE;
  Error := True;
  swStatus := 16#8202;
ELSIF ModePos < 1 THEN
  
  sbModePos := FALSE;
  Error := True;
  swStatus := 16#8202;
ELSE
  // Betriebsartenwechsel ist nur mÃ¶glich, wenn die Achse nicht beschleunigt oder nicht verzÃ¶gert
  // und die Geschwindigkeit Null ist
  IF NOT sbFWD AND NOT sbBWD AND NOT sbAccel AND NOT sbDecel THEN
    
    sbModePos := TRUE;
    siModePos := ModePos;
    
    // Fehler wieder zurÃ¼cknehmen, wenn er mal ausgelÃ¶st wurde
    IF swStatus = 16#8202 THEN
      swStatus := 16#7002;
      Error := False;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
END_IF;

// ÃœberprÃ¼fung der analogen Eingabewerte, ob sie innerhalb des mÃ¶glichen Bereiches liegen
// Geschwindigkeitsoverride (0% - 199%, 100% => W#16#4000)
IF (OverV < 0) OR (OverV > 199) THEN
  swStatus := 16#8203;
  Error := True;
ELSE
  // Geschwindigkeitsoverride in den Sendepuffer eintragen
  sxSendBuf.OverrideV := INT_TO_WORD();
END_IF;

// Beschleunigungsoverride (0% - 100%, 100% => W#16#4000)
IF (OverAcc < 0) OR (OverAcc > 100) THEN
  swStatus := 16#8203;
  Error := True;
ELSE
  // Beschleunigungsoverride in den Sendepuffer eintragen
  sxSendBuf.OverrideA := INT_TO_WORD();
END_IF;

// VerzÃ¶gerungsoverride (0% - 100%, 100% => W#16#4000)
IF (OverDec < 0) OR (OverDec > 100) THEN
  swStatus := 16#8203;
  Error := True;
ELSE
  // VerzÃ¶gerungsoverride in den Sendepuffer eintragen
  sxSendBuf.OverrideD := INT_TO_WORD();
END_IF;

// Fehler wieder zurÃ¼cknehmen, wenn er mal ausgelÃ¶st wurde
IF NOT (OverV < 0) AND NOT (OverV > 199) AND NOT (OverAcc < 0) AND NOT (OverAcc > 100) AND
  NOT (OverDec < 0) AND NOT (OverDec > 100) THEN
  IF swStatus = 16#8203 THEN
    swStatus := 16#7002;
    Error := False;
  END_IF;
END_IF;

// Positionssollwert
// Positionssollwert in den Sendepuffer eintragen
sxSendBuf.Position := DINT_TO_DWORD();

// Geschwindigkeitssollwert (Begrenzung / Ãœberwachung
// Geschwindigkeitssollwert in den Sendepuffer eintragen
sxSendBuf.Velocity := DINT_TO_DWORD();

// Einschalten bzw. Ausschalten des Antriebes erkennen
IF EnableAxis AND NOT sbOff1Edge AND NOT sbBusy AND sbModePos THEN
  sbOff1 := True;
END_IF;
// Einschalten bzw. Ausschalten des Antriebes Flanke merken
sbOff1Edge := EnableAxis AND NOT sbBusy;

// Einschaltflankenmerker wieder zurÃ¼cksetzen
IF NOT EnableAxis THEN
  sbOff1 := False;
END_IF;

// Fliegendes Referenzieren aktivieren erkennen
IF FlyRef AND NOT sbRefTypEdge THEN
  sbRefTyp := True;
END_IF;
// Fliegendes Referenzieren aktivieren Flanke merken
sbRefTypEdge := FlyRef;

// Fliegendes Referenzieren Flankenmerker wieder zurÃ¼cksetzen
IF NOT FlyRef THEN
  sbRefTyp := False;
  siRefTypCyc := 0;
END_IF;

// Betriebsart aktivieren erkennen (RQ 3901129, RQ 4094299)
IF ExecuteMode AND NOT sbExecuteEdge THEN
  sbExecute := True;
  siExecuteCyc := 0;
ELSIF ActMode <> ModePos THEN
  sbExecute := FALSE;
ELSIF siExecuteCyc > (2 * siCycWait) THEN
  IF ModePos <> 4 THEN
    sbExecute := FALSE;
  ELSE
    IF sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X11 OR NOT ExecuteMode THEN
      sbExecute := FALSE;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
ELSE
  ; // not used
END_IF;

IF siExecuteCyc > 100 THEN
  siExecuteCyc := 0;
ELSE
  siExecuteCyc := siExecuteCyc + 1;
END_IF;

// Verfahrauftrag aktivieren Flanke merken
sbExecuteEdge := ExecuteMode;

// Betriebsart MDI / Sollwertdirektvorgabe Flanke merken
// IF #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiStart AND NOT #sbMdiStartEdge THEN
          #sbMdiStart := True;
      END_IF;
      // Betriebsart MDI / Sollwertdirektvorgabe Flanke merken
      #sbMdiStartEdge := #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiStart AND NOT #Busy;

// Verfahrauftragflankenmerker wieder zurÃ¼cksetzen
// IF NOT #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiStart THEN
          #sbMdiStart := False;
          #siMdiStartCyc := 0;
      END_IF;

IF sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 AND NOT sbMdiStartEdge THEN
  sbMdiStart := True;
END_IF;
// Betriebsart MDI / Sollwertdirektvorgabe Flanke merken
sbMdiStartEdge := sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 AND NOT sbBusy;

// Verfahrauftragflankenmerker wieder zurÃ¼cksetzen
IF NOT sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 THEN
  sbMdiStart := False;
  siMdiStartCyc := 0;
END_IF;

// Schreibdaten zusammenstellen
// Steuerword STW1 fÃ¼r alle Betriebsart aufbereiten
// #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RejTrvTsk        := #RejTrvTsk;
      #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.IntMStop         := #IntMStop;
      #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.AckFault         := #AckFlt;

sxSendBuf.STW1.%X4 := CancelTraversing;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X5 := IntermediateStop;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X7 := AckError;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X1 := TRUE;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X2 := TRUE;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X3 := TRUE;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X10 := TRUE;

// Hauptbetriebsart "Positionieren / manueller Sollwertvorgabe (MDI)"
// Betriebsart "Positionieren Relativ positiv" oder "Positionieren Relativ negativ"
IF (siModePos = 1 AND sbModePos) THEN
  
  // Antrieb einschalten
  // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.Off1 := #sbOff1;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X0 := sbOff1;
  
  // nicht verwendete Signale fÃ¼r den 1. Schritt und eventuell weitere Schritte
  // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.Jog1          := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.Jog2          := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiTyp    := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiPos    := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiNeg    := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiSetup  := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.SetRefPt  := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.JogInc    := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.RefStDi   := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RefStart      := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.RefTyp    := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiStart  := False;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X8 := False;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X9 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X8 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X9 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X10 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X14 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X1 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X5 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X9 := False;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X8 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 := False;
  
  
  // Nach dem Einschalten des Antriebes, prÃ¼fen ob der Antrieb betriebsbereit, in Operation ohne Fehler und Warnung ist,
  // dann die Betriebsart MDI / Sollwertvorgabe Start gesetzt werden
  IF sbOff1 AND sbReady AND sbIOp AND NOT sbFault THEN
    
    // Betriebsart MDI / Sollwertdirektvorgabe setzen
    // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiStart := True;
    sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 := True;
    
    // Positioniertyp auf relatives Positionieren stellen
    // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiTyp := False;
    sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X8 := False;
    
    // die Richtungswahl fÃ¼r das Positionieren auf positive Richtung oder negative Richtung einstellen
    IF Positive AND NOT Negative THEN
      
      // positive Richtung
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiPos := True;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X9 := True;
      
      // negative Richtung
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiNeg := False;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X10 := False;
      
      // die Richtungswahl fÃ¼r das Positionieren auf negative Richtung einstellen
    ELSIF NOT Positive AND Negative THEN
      
      // positive Richtung
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiPos := False;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X9 := False;
      
      // negative Richtung
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiNeg := True;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X10 := True;
      
      // die Richtungswahl fÃ¼r das Positionieren auf keine Richtung einstellen
    ELSE
      
      // positive Richtung
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiPos := False;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X9 := False;
      
      // negative Richtung
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiNeg := False;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X10 := False;
      
    END_IF;
    
    // Nach dem Einschalten des Antriebes und dem Betriebsart MDI / Sollwertvorgabe starten,
    // ein Paar Zyklen warten bevor die Flanke fÃ¼r die SollwertÃ¼bernahme MDI gesetzt werden kann
    IF sbMdiStart AND (siMdiStartCyc < siCycWait) THEN
      siMdiStartCyc := siMdiStartCyc + 1;
    ELSE
      // Flanke SollwertÃ¼bernahme MDI
      // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.TrvStart := #Execute;
      sxSendBuf.STW1.%X6 := sbExecute;
      
    END_IF;
    
    // "Fliegendes Referentieren" aktivieren
    // "Fliegendes Referenzieren" erst nach Einschalten des Antriebes mÃ¶glich
    IF sbRefTyp THEN
      
      // Referenziertyp auf "Fliegendes Referenzieren" einstellen
      // #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.RefTyp := True;
      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X8 := True;
      
      // Nach der Anwahl des Referenziertyps "Fliegendes Referenzieren",
      // ein Zyklus spÃ¤ter kann das Referenzieren gestartet
      IF (siRefTypCyc = 0) THEN
        siRefTypCyc := siRefTypCyc + 1;
      ELSE
        // Referenzieren starten
        // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RefStart := True;
        sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 := True;
        
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
  
  // Betriebsart "Positionieren Absolut" oder "Positonieren Absolut positiv" oder "Positionieren Absolut negativ"
ELSIF siModePos = 2 AND sbModePos THEN
  
  // Antrieb einschalten
  // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.Off1 := #sbOff1;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X0 := sbOff1;
  
  // nicht verwendete Signale fÃ¼r den 1. Schritt und eventuell weitere Schritte
  // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.Jog1         := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.Jog2         := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiTyp   := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiPos   := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiNeg   := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiSetup := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.SetRefPt := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.JogInc   := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.RefStDi  := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RefStart     := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW2.RefTyp   := False;
          #sxSendBuf.sxEPosSTW1.MdiStart := False;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X8 := False;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X9 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X8 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X9 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X10 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X14 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X1 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X5 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X9 := False;
  sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X8 := False;
  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 := False;
  
  // Nach dem Einschalten des Antriebes, prÃ¼fen ob der Antrieb betriebsbereit, in Operation ohne Fehler und Warnung ist,

    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFFE;

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X5 THEN

    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 08 --> 1 = STOP cam minus active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.StpCamMinAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X8 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#100;

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X9 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#200;

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X10 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X11 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#800;

    // IF NOT #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.FlyRefAct AND #sbRefTyp AND #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RefStart THEN
    IF NOT sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X12 AND sbRefTyp AND sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 THEN
      
      // Wiederholung anstossen
      IF siRefActRetry < siRetryMax THEN
        siRefActRetry := siRefActRetry + 1;
        
        // Referenzieren starten wieder wegnehmen

        sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 := False;

      IF (sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X12 AND sbRefTyp AND sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11) OR NOT FlyRef THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X14 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X15 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X2 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X5 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X6 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X7 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#80;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FF7F;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 08 --> 1 = Position actual value <= cam position 1

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X8 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X9 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X12 THEN

    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X15 THEN

  IF NOT sbFault THEN
    
    // Referenzpunktfahrt negativ

ELSIF siModePos = 6 AND sbModePos THEN

    IF (DINT_TO_WORD() AND W#16#01) = W#16#01 THEN

    // Verfahrsatznummer Bit 1 ermitteln

    // Verfahrsatznummer Bit 5 ermitteln

    // Nach dem Einschalten des Antriebes, prÃ¼fen ob der Antrieb betriebsbereit, in Operation ohne Fehler und Warnung ist,

    IF sbOff1 AND sbReady AND sbIOp AND NOT sbFault THEN
      
      // Positioniertyp auf absolutes Positionieren stellen

      IF sbMdiStart AND (siMdiStartCyc < siCycWait) THEN
        siMdiStartCyc := siMdiStartCyc + 1;

  // Hauptbetriebsart "Tippen" (Jogging)

ELSIF siModePos = 7 AND sbModePos THEN
  
  // Antrieb einschalten

  // Nach dem Einschalten des Antriebes, prÃ¼fen ob der Antrieb betriebsbereit, in Operation ohne Fehler und Warnung ist,
  // dann kann Tippen positiv oder negativ gesetzt werden
  IF sbOff1 AND sbReady AND sbIOp AND NOT sbFault THEN
    
    // Tippen positiv
    IF Jog1 AND NOT Jog2 THEN

    IF Jog2 AND NOT Jog1 THEN

      sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X8 := FlyRef;

  sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X15 := False;

  // Nach dem Einschalten des Antriebes, ein Paar Zyklen warten bevor Tippen negativ gesetzt werden kann

  IF sbOff1 AND sbReady AND sbIOp AND NOT sbFault THEN

      // Tippen positiv oder negativ inkrementell zulassen
      IF Jog1 XOR Jog2 THEN

        sxSendBuf.STW1.%X8 := Jog1;

// Den Eingang ConfigEPos auf die einzelnen Bits im Telegramm verschalten
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X1 := ConfigEPos.%X0;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X2 := ConfigEPos.%X1;
sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X14 := ConfigEPos.%X2;
sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X15 := ConfigEPos.%X3;
sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X11 := ConfigEPos.%X4;
sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2.%X10 := ConfigEPos.%X5;

sxSendBuf.STW1.%X13 := ConfigEPos.%X7;
sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1.%X12 := ConfigEPos.%X8;
sxSendBuf.STW2.%X0 := ConfigEPos.%X9;
sxSendBuf.STW2.%X1 := ConfigEPos.%X10;
sxSendBuf.STW2.%X2 := ConfigEPos.%X11;
sxSendBuf.STW2.%X3 := ConfigEPos.%X12;
sxSendBuf.STW2.%X4 := ConfigEPos.%X13;

swSendBuf[0] := sxSendBuf.STW1;
swSendBuf[1] := sxSendBuf.EPosSTW1;
swSendBuf[2] := sxSendBuf.EPosSTW2;
swSendBuf[3] := sxSendBuf.STW2;
swSendBuf[4] := sxSendBuf.OverrideV;
swSendBuf[5] := sxSendBuf.Position.%W1;
swSendBuf[6] := sxSendBuf.Position.%W0;
swSendBuf[7] := sxSendBuf.Velocity.%W1;
swSendBuf[8] := sxSendBuf.Velocity.%W0;
swSendBuf[9] := sxSendBuf.OverrideA;
swSendBuf[10] := sxSendBuf.OverrideD;
swSendBuf[11] := sxSendBuf.Reserve;

// Prozessdaten zur Signalbaugruppe schreiben
piRetSFC := DPWR_DAT(LADDR := HWIDSTW,                      RECORD := swSendBuf);

// Fehler der RÃ¼ckmeldung ausgeben
DiagID := INT_TO_WORD();

// kein Fehler beim Schreiben
IF piRetSFC = 0 THEN
  
  // Fehler wieder zurÃ¼ck nehmen
  IF (swStatus = 16#8601) THEN
    swStatus := 16#7002;
    Error := False;
  END_IF;
  
  // Prozessdaten von der Signalbaugruppe lesen
  piRetSFC := DPRD_DAT(LADDR := HWIDZSW,                        RECORD => swRecvBuf);
  
  // Fehlermeldung der RÃ¼ckmeldung ausgeben
  DiagID := INT_TO_WORD();
  
  // Fehler beim Lesen (Profibus-Kommunikation unterbrochen)
  IF piRetSFC <> 0 THEN
    
    // Fehler
    Error := TRUE;
    swStatus := 16#8600;
    
    // Zustandsworte lÃ¶schen
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1 := W#16#0;
    sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1 := W#16#0;
    sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2 := W#16#0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW2 := W#16#0;
    sxRecvBuf.NotUsed := W#16#00;
    sxRecvBuf.Position := DW#16#00;
    sxRecvBuf.Velocity := DW#16#00;
    sxRecvBuf.ErrNr := W#16#00;
    sxRecvBuf.WarnNr := W#16#00;
    sxRecvBuf.Reserve := W#16#00;
    
    // Werte auslesen
  ELSE
    
    // Fehler wieder zurÃ¼ck nehmen
    IF (swStatus = 16#8600) THEN
      swStatus := 16#7002;
      Error := False;
    END_IF;
    
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1 := swRecvBuf[0];
    sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1 := swRecvBuf[1];
    sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2 := swRecvBuf[2];
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW2 := swRecvBuf[3];
    sxRecvBuf.NotUsed := swRecvBuf[4];
    sxRecvBuf.Position.%W1 := swRecvBuf[5];
    sxRecvBuf.Position.%W0 := swRecvBuf[6];
    sxRecvBuf.Velocity.%W1 := swRecvBuf[7];
    sxRecvBuf.Velocity.%W0 := swRecvBuf[8];
    sxRecvBuf.ErrNr := swRecvBuf[9];
    sxRecvBuf.WarnNr := swRecvBuf[10];
    sxRecvBuf.Reserve := swRecvBuf[11];
    
    // ZSW1 aufbereiten
    // #Busy := #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.IOp;
    sbBusy := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X2;
    
    // Fehler auswerten
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Fault THEN
                  #ErrorId := 5;
                  #Error := True;
              ELSIF #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.PowInhbt THEN 
                  #ErrorId := 6;
                  #Error := True;
              ELSE
                  // Fehler wieder zurÃ¼ck nehmen
                  IF (#ErrorId = 5) OR (#ErrorId = 6) THEN
                      #ErrorId := 0;    
                      #Error := False;
                  END_IF;
              END_IF;
    IF sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X3 THEN
      swStatus := 16#8401;
      Error := True;
    ELSIF sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X6 THEN
      swStatus := 16#8402;
      Error := True;
    ELSE
      // Fehler wieder zurÃ¼ck nehmen
      IF (swStatus = 16#8401) OR (swStatus = 16#8402) THEN
        swStatus := 16#7002;
        Error := False;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS_ZSW1
    // EPOS-Wort-1 BIT 00 --> 1 = Active traversing block bit 0
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.ActTrvBit0 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X0 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#01;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFFE;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 01 --> 1 = Active traversing block bit 1
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.ActTrvBit1 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X1 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#02;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFFD;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 02 --> 1 = Active traversing block bit 2
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.ActTrvBit2 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X2 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#04;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFFB;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 03 --> 1 = Active traversing block bit 3
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.ActTrvBit3 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X3 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#08;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFF7;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 04 --> 1 = Active traversing block bit 4
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.ActTrvBit4 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X4 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#10;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFEF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 05 --> 1 = Active traversing block bit 5
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.ActTrvBit5 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X5 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#20;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FFDF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 08 --> 1 = STOP cam minus active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.StpCamMinAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X8 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#100;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FEFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 09 --> 1 = STOP cam plus active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.StpCamPlsAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X9 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#200;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FDFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 10 --> 1 = Jogging active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.JogAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X10 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#400;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#FBFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 11 --> 1 = Reference point approach active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.RefAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X11 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#800;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#F7FF;
    END_IF;
    
    // Anstossen des fliegenden Referenzieren prÃ¼fen, wenn die RÃ¼ckmeldung fehlt dann wiederholen
    // IF NOT #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.FlyRefAct AND #sbRefTyp AND #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RefStart THEN
    IF NOT sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X12 AND sbRefTyp AND sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 THEN
      
      // Wiederholung anstossen
      IF siRefActRetry < siRetryMax THEN
        siRefActRetry := siRefActRetry + 1;
        
        // Referenzieren starten wieder wegnehmen
        // #sxSendBuf.sxSTW1.RefStart := False;
        sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 := False;
      ELSE
        
        // Fehlermeldung
        swStatus := 16#8403;
        Error := True;
      END_IF;
    ELSE
      
      // Fehler wieder zurÃ¼cknehmen, wenn er mal ausgelÃ¶st wurde
      IF swStatus = 16#8403 THEN
        swStatus := 16#7002;
        Error := False;
      END_IF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 12 --> 1 = Flying referencing active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.FlyRefAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X12 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#1000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#EFFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 13 --> 1 = Traversing block active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.TrvBlAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X13 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#2000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#DFFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 14 --> 1 = MDI setup active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.MdiStupAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X14 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#4000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#BFFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-1 Bit 15 --> 1 = MDI positing active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW1.MdiPosAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW1.%X15 THEN
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 OR W#16#8000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1 AND W#16#7FFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS_ZSW2
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 00 --> 1 = Tracking mode active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.TrkModeAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X0 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#01;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFFE;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 01 --> 1 = Velocity limit active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.VeloLimAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X1 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#02;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFFD;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 02 --> 1 = Setpoint static
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.SetPStat THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X2 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#04;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFFB;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 03 --> 1 = Printmark outside outer window
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.PrnMrkOut THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X3 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#08;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFF7;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 04 --> 1 = Axis forwards
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.FWD THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X4 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#10;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFEF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 05 --> 1 = Axis backwards
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.BWD THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X5 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#20;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFDF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 06 --> 1 = Software limit switch minus active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.SftSwMinAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X6 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#40;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FFBF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 07 --> 1 = Software limit switch plus active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.SftSwPlsAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X7 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#80;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FF7F;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 08 --> 1 = Position actual value <= cam position 1
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.PosSmCam1 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X8 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#100;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FEFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 09 --> 1 = Position actual value <= cam position 2
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.PosSmCam2 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X9 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#200;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FDFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 10 --> 1 = Direct output 1 via traversing block
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.TrvOut1 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X10 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#400;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#FBFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 11 --> 1 = Direct output 2 via traversing block
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.TrvOut2 THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X11 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#800;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#F7FF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 12 --> 1 = Fixed STOP reached
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.FxStpRd THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X12 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#1000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#EFFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 13 --> 1 = Fixed STOP clamping torque reached
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.FxStpTrRd THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X13 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#2000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#DFFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 14 --> 1 = Traversing fixed STOP active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.TrvFxStpAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X14 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#4000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#BFFF;
    END_IF;
    
    // EPOS-Wort-2 Bit 15 --> 1 = Traversing command active
    // IF #sxRecvBuf.sxEPosZSW2.CmdAct THEN
    IF sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X15 THEN
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 OR W#16#8000;
    ELSE
      swEPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2 AND W#16#7FFF;
    END_IF;
    
    sbReady := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X1;
    
    AxisEnabled := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X2;
    sbIOp := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X2;
    
    AxisError := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X3;
    sbFault := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X3;
    
    AxisWarn := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X7;
    sbAlarm := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X7;
    
    AxisPosOk := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X10;
    AxisRef := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X11;// /
    
    sbAccel := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X14;
    sbDecel := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X15;
    
    ActVelocity := DWORD_TO_DINT();
    ActPosition := DWORD_TO_DINT();
    ActMode := ModePos;
    ActWarn := sxRecvBuf.WarnNr;
    ActFault := sxRecvBuf.ErrNr;
    
    Lockout := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X6;
    
    SWUpLimit := sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X7;
    
    SWLowLimit := sxRecvBuf.EPosZSW2.%X6;
  END_IF;
ELSE
  
  // Fehler
  Error := TRUE;
  swStatus := 16#8601;
  
END_IF;

// Initialisierung von Ausgã­§en
Status := swStatus;
EPosZSW1 := swEPosZSW1;
EPosZSW2 := swEPosZSW2;


// Jason 20190320
IF AxisEnabled AND ConfigEPos.%X6 OR sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X11 THEN
    AxisRef := true;
END_IF;
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/10_è¥¿é—¨å­SCLçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/SINA_SPEED.scl// source: real TIA V17 project ç¤ºä¾‹ç¨‹åº.ap17 (S7-1500 standard-program
//         template), block exported via Openness and reconstructed to SCL
//         on 2026-09-09 (plc-code corpus campaign).
// block: SINA_SPEED | language: SCL
FUNCTION_BLOCK "SINA_SPEED"

VAR_INPUT
   EnableAxis : Bool NonRetain;
   AckError : Bool NonRetain;
   SpeedSp : Real NonRetain;
   RefSpeed : Real NonRetain;
   ConfigAxis : Word NonRetain;
   HWIDSTW : HW_IO NonRetain;
   HWIDZSW : HW_IO NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
   AxisEnabled : Bool NonRetain;
   Lockout : Bool NonRetain;
   ActVelocity : Real NonRetain;
   Error : Bool NonRetain;
   Status : Word NonRetain;
   DiagId : Word NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR
   sxSendBuf : Struct NonRetain;
   sxRecvBuf : Struct NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_TEMP
   piRetSFC : Int;
   piCount : Int;
   prVelocity : Real;
   pdRecvBuf : DWord;
   pdSendBuf : DWord;
   phLAddr : HW_IO;
   swSendBuf : Array[0..1] of Word;
   swRecvBuf : Array[0..1] of Word;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

// ---- implementation ----
// =============================================================================
// SIEMENS AG
// (c)Copyright 2017 All Rights Reserved
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Library: DriveLib
// Tested with: S7-1516-3 PN/DP V1.8
// Engineering: TIA Portal V14
// Restrictions: -
// Requirements: S7-1200 / S7-1500
// Functionality: cyclic communication between a SINAMICS a PLC.
// If in HWConfig Std.TLG 1 is projected 2 PZD-words are exchanged
// in every bus cycle.
// The parametrisation of these words is described in the manual of the
// SINAMICS
// =============================================================================

// Schreibdaten zusammenstellen
// Steuerword aufbereiten

sxSendBuf.STW1.%X0 := EnableAxis;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X1 := ConfigAxis.%X0;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X2 := ConfigAxis.%X1;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X3 := ConfigAxis.%X2;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X4 := ConfigAxis.%X3;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X5 := ConfigAxis.%X4;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X6 := ConfigAxis.%X5;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X10 := TRUE;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X11 := ConfigAxis.%X6;
sxSendBuf.STW1.%X7 := AckError;

// Geschwindigkeit
IF RefSpeed <> 0 THEN
  prVelocity := SpeedSp * (16384.0 / RefSpeed);
  // Limit REAL - Variable to INT - Limits
  IF prVelocity > 32767 THEN
    prVelocity := 32767;
  ELSIF prVelocity < -32768 THEN
    prVelocity := -32768;
  ELSE
    ; // not needed
  END_IF;
  sxSendBuf.Velocity := INT_TO_WORD();
  
ELSE
  sxSendBuf.Velocity := W#16#0;
END_IF;
swSendBuf[0] := sxSendBuf.STW1;
swSendBuf[1] := sxSendBuf.Velocity;

// Prozessdaten zur Signalbaugruppe schreiben
piRetSFC := DPWR_DAT(LADDR := HWIDSTW,                      RECORD := swSendBuf);

// Fehler der RÃƒÂ¼ckmeldung ausgeben
DiagId := INT_TO_WORD();

// kein Fehler beim Schreiben
IF piRetSFC = 0 THEN
  
  // kein Fehler beim Schreiben
  IF piRetSFC = 0 THEN
    
    // Prozessdaten von der Signalbaugruppe lesen
    piRetSFC := DPRD_DAT(LADDR := HWIDZSW,                          RECORD => swRecvBuf);
    
    // Fehler der RÃƒÂ¼ckmeldung ausgeben
    DiagId := INT_TO_WORD();
  END_IF;
  
  // Fehler beim Lesen (Profibus-Kommunikation unterbrochen)
  IF piRetSFC <> 0 THEN
    
    // Fehler
    Error := TRUE;
    Status := 16#8600;
    
    // Zustandsworte lÃƒÂ¶schen
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X8 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X9 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X10 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X11 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X12 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X13 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X14 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X15 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X0 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X1 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X2 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X3 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X4 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X5 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X6 := 0;
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X7 := 0;
    
    
    // #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.SpDev   := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Pcd     := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Comp    := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.CurLim  := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Brake   := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Motover := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Dir     := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Invover := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Rts     := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Rdy     := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.IOp     := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Fault   := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.NoOff2  := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.NoOff3  := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Inhibit := 0;
    #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Alarm   := 0;
    
    sxRecvBuf.Velocity := W#16#00;
    
    // Werte auslesen
  ELSE
    sxRecvBuf.ZSW1 := swRecvBuf[0];
    sxRecvBuf.Velocity := swRecvBuf[1];
    
    // ZSW1 aufbereiten
    AxisEnabled := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X2;
    Error := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X3 OR sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X6;
    Lockout := sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X6;
    
    // Fehler auswerten
    IF sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X3 THEN
      Status := 16#8401;
    ELSIF sxRecvBuf.ZSW1.%X6 THEN
      Status := 16#8402;
    ELSE
      Status := 16#7002;
    END_IF;
    
    // #Busy       := #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.IOp;
    #Error      := #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Fault OR #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Inhibit;
    #PwrInhibit := #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Inhibit;            

    // Fehler auswerten
    IF #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Fault THEN
        #ErrorId := 1;
    ELSIF #sxRecvBuf.sxZSW1.Inhibit THEN 
        #ErrorId := 2;
    ELSE
        #ErrorId := 0;    
    END_IF;
    
    // Geschwindigkeit
    IF RefSpeed <> 0 THEN
      ActVelocity := INT_TO_REAL() / (16384.0 / RefSpeed);
    ELSE
      ActVelocity := 0.0;
    END_IF;
  END_IF;
ELSE
      
  // Fehler
  Error := TRUE;
  Status := 16#8601;
    
END_IF;
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/10_è¥¿é—¨å­SCLçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/STATION_STATUS_FB.scl// source: real TIA V17 project ç¤ºä¾‹ç¨‹åº.ap17 (S7-1500 standard-program

FUNCTION_BLOCK "STATION_STATUS_FB"

   STATION_STATUSES : Array[0..#NumberOfStations] of "STATION_STATUS_PLTCP_8315_UDT" NonRetain;
   DATA_STATUS : Bool NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT

   OUT_STATION_STATUS : Array[0..#NumberOfStations] of "STATION_STATUS_INIT_UDT" NonRetain;
   OUT_LINE_STATUS : "LINE_STATUS_UDT" NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR
   StationStatusDetail : Array[0..#NumberOfStations] of "STATION_STATUS_INIT_UDT" NonRetain;
   laststationStatusMessage : Array[0..#NumberOfStations] of "STATION_STATUS_PLTCP_8315_UDT" RETAIN;
   NumOfStationsMem : Int NonRetain;
   PLCSysTimeInitial : LTime NonRetain;
   OverAllLoopTime : LTime NonRetain;
   PLCSysTime : LTime NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_TEMP
   i : Int;
   k : Int;
   j : Int;
   _min : Int;
   Ret_Val : Int;
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
   NumberOfStations : UInt;
   SCToolsDisconnected : UInt;
   SCLeadRequest : UInt;
   SCToolAssistance : UInt;
   SCTempStop : UInt;
   SCFixedStop : UInt;
   SCTasksComplete : UInt;
   Unknown : UInt;
END_VAR

                 .:+ydmMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMNNNMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMNdyo/.

                   -mMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMm/   -hMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMN+

|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
| FC Name: StationStatus | Tanvir Mudhar <tmudhar@tesla.com>
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Purpose: Accepts single messages from PLTCP Station Status UDT, then retains their status in
| an orgaized manner for the PLC to keep trake of the states.
|
| Pre-Conditions: PLTCP Communication Block must provide an 'okay' signal to continue.
| Data format must be:
|    StationStatus {
|      StationID string[20]
|      Component int
|      Status int
|   }
|
| Paramters:

| Returns:
|  Statues organized by Station Names, and retains their last value from client.

REGION 
    Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
    IF NumOfStationsMem = 0 THEN
        ;
        IF NumberOfStations <> NumberOfStations THEN
            OUT_ERROR.Error := 0;
            OUT_ERROR.Info := 0;
            OUT_ERROR.Warning := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Station Array (automatic) not equal to number of stations constant - not all data being processed';
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
    
    IF laststationStatusMessage = STATION_STATUSES THEN
        OUT_ERROR.Error := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Info := 1;
        OUT_ERROR.Warning := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Description := 'No Change in Data';
        Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
        OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
        RETURN; // Exit FB Immediately.
    ELSIF DATA_STATUS = 0 THEN
        OUT_ERROR.Error := 1;
        OUT_ERROR.Info := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Warning := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Description := 'PLTCP not working as expected';
        Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
        OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
        RETURN; // Exit FB Immediately.
    ELSE
        laststationStatusMessage := STATION_STATUSES;
        OUT_LINE_STATUS.ToolsDisconnected := 0;
        OUT_LINE_STATUS.FixedStop := 0;
        OUT_LINE_STATUS.TempStop := 0;
        OUT_LINE_STATUS.LeadRequest := 0;
        OUT_LINE_STATUS.ToolAssistence := 0;
        OUT_LINE_STATUS.TasksComplete := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Error := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Info := 1;
        OUT_ERROR.Warning := 0;
        OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Starting to process data from stream';
        
    END_IF;
END_REGION

REGION 
    FOR i := 0 TO NumOfStationsMem DO
        StationStatusDetail[i].Name := laststationStatusMessage[i].StationID;
        IF StationStatusDetail[i].Name = '' THEN
            OUT_ERROR.Warning := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Not all stations are defined, reduce procssing by reducing array size';
            
            Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
            OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
            EXIT;
        END_IF;
        
        IF laststationStatusMessage[i].Component = SCToolsDisconnected THEN
            StationStatusDetail[i].ToolDisconnected := laststationStatusMessage[i].Status;
            
        ELSIF laststationStatusMessage[i].Component = SCTasksComplete THEN
            StationStatusDetail[i].TaskComplete := laststationStatusMessage[i].Status;
            
        ELSIF laststationStatusMessage[i].Component = SCLeadRequest THEN
            StationStatusDetail[i].LeadRequest := laststationStatusMessage[i].Status;
            
        ELSIF laststationStatusMessage[i].Component = SCToolAssistance THEN
            StationStatusDetail[i].ToolAssistReq := laststationStatusMessage[i].Status;
            
        ELSIF laststationStatusMessage[i].Component = SCTempStop THEN
            StationStatusDetail[i].TempStopReq := laststationStatusMessage[i].Status;
            
        ELSIF laststationStatusMessage[i].Component = SCFixedStop THEN
            StationStatusDetail[i].FixedStopReq := laststationStatusMessage[i].Status;
            
        ELSE
            OUT_ERROR.Error := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := CONCAT(IN1 := 'Unknown Component in Message - Update Block to include compoenet #:', IN2 := INT_TO_STRING());
        END_IF;
        
        Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
        OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
        
        IF OverAllLoopTime > T#2ms THEN
            OUT_ERROR.Error := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Too much time in loop, EXITing early';
            EXIT;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_REGION

REGION 
    OUT_STATION_STATUS := StationStatusDetail;
    
    FOR j := 0 TO NumOfStationsMem DO
        IF StationStatusDetail[j].Name = '' THEN
            OUT_ERROR.Warning := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Not all stations are defined, reduce procssing by reducing array size';
            
            Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
            OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
            EXIT;
        ELSIF StationStatusDetail[j].TempStopReq = 1 THEN
            OUT_LINE_STATUS.TempStop := 1;
            
        ELSIF StationStatusDetail[j].FixedStopReq = 1 THEN
            OUT_LINE_STATUS.FixedStop := 1;
            
        ELSIF StationStatusDetail[j].LeadRequest = 1 THEN
            OUT_LINE_STATUS.LeadRequest := 1;
            
        ELSIF StationStatusDetail[j].TaskComplete = 1 OR
            StationStatusDetail[j].TaskComplete = 0 THEN
            _min := 32766;
            FOR k := 0 TO j DO
                _min := MIN(IN1 := _min, IN2 := StationStatusDetail[k].TaskComplete);
            END_FOR;
            OUT_LINE_STATUS.TasksComplete := INT_TO_BOOL();
            
        ELSIF StationStatusDetail[j].ToolDisconnected = 1 THEN
            OUT_LINE_STATUS.ToolsDisconnected := 1;
            
        ELSIF StationStatusDetail[j].ToolAssistReq = 1 THEN
            OUT_LINE_STATUS.ToolAssistence := 1;
            
        ELSE
            OUT_ERROR.Warning := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Unknown';
        END_IF;
        
        Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
        OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
        
        
        IF OverAllLoopTime > T#2ms THEN
            OUT_ERROR.Error := True;
            OUT_ERROR.Description := 'Too much time in loop, EXITing early';
            EXIT;
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
END_REGION

Ret_Val := RD_SYS_T();
OverAllLoopTime := PLCSysTime - PLCSysTimeInitial;
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/10_è¥¿é—¨å­SCLçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/SerialCom.scl// source: real TIA V17 project ç¤ºä¾‹ç¨‹åº.ap17 (S7-1500 standard-program
//         template), block exported via Openness and reconstructed to SCL
//         on 2026-09-09 (plc-code corpus campaign).
// block: SerialCom | language: SCL
FUNCTION_BLOCK "SerialCom"

VAR_INPUT
   aInput : Array[0..47] of Byte NonRetain;
   SizeModule : Int NonRetain;
   Send : Array[0..1000] of Byte NonRetain;
   Send_from_ByteNo : Int NonRetain;
   Send_n_Bytes : Int NonRetain;
   SizeReceiveDB : Int NonRetain;
   UsedCouplerIs_303 : Bool NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
   aOutput : Array[0..47] of Byte NonRetain;
   Receive : Array[0..1000] of Byte NonRetain;
   bFeedback : Byte NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
   SendRequest : Bool NonRetain;
   Receive_next_byte : Int NonRetain;
   xReset : Bool NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR
   in_pbRxWin : Array[0..47] of Byte NonRetain;
   in_pbTxWin : Array[0..47] of Byte NonRetain;
   ControlByte_0 : Byte NonRetain;
   ControlByte_1 : Byte NonRetain;
   init : Bool NonRetain;
   Adr_Tx : Int NonRetain;
   Adr_Rx : Int NonRetain;
   aux1 : Bool NonRetain;
   Trans_pointer : DInt NonRetain;
   count : Int NonRetain;
   stateInit : Int NonRetain;
END_VAR
VAR_TEMP
   c : Int;
   Adr : Int;
   DB_LENGTH : Word;
   WRITE_PROT : Bool;
   rTEST_DB : Int;
   i : Int;
   aux4 : Byte;
   Adr_out : Int;
   SCL_MIGRA_TEMP_INT_1 : Int;
   Migra_DB_LENGTH : UDInt;
END_VAR
VAR CONSTANT
   USE_SENDBUFFER : Bool;
   SENDBUFFERSIZE_652 : Int;
   SENDBUFFERSIZE_65x : Int;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

// ---- implementation ----
IF UsedCouplerIs_303 AND SizeModule=4 THEN// Prozessabbild muss angepasst werden
    // Eingangsdaten kopieren und drehen
   
   in_pbRxWin[0] := aInput[1];
   in_pbRxWin[1] := aInput[0];
   in_pbRxWin[2] := aInput[3];
   in_pbRxWin[3] := aInput[2];
ELSE    
    // Eingangsdaten kopieren
   
    FOR i := 0 TO SizeModule - 1 DO
        in_pbRxWin[i] := aInput[i];
    END_FOR;
   
END_IF;    



// *** Reset am Baustein  ? ****************************************
IF xReset THEN // Reset von Benutzer angefordert   
    CASE stateInit OF
        0: 
            in_pbTxWin[0] :=16#04;
            in_pbTxWin[1] :=16#00;
            stateInit:=1;
        1: 
           IF (in_pbRxWin[0] AND 16#04)=16#04 THEN
                in_pbTxWin[0] :=16#00;
                stateInit:=2;
           END_IF;
        2:    
           IF (in_pbRxWin[0] AND 16#04)=16#00 THEN // fertig mit Initialisierung
                stateInit:=0;
                xReset:=false;
                Receive_next_byte:=0;
                SendRequest:=false;
                Trans_pointer := 0;
                FOR i := 0 TO SizeReceiveDB DO
                    Receive[i] := 0;
                END_FOR;
           END_IF;
 
    END_CASE;
ELSE// ab hier Senden und Empfangen

    IF SizeModule<8 THEN
    // *****************************hier Modul 750-650**************************************************************
        
        ControlByte_0 := in_pbTxWin[0];
        
         // --- MUSS ZEICHEN GESENDET WERDEN ? ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF SendRequest AND Trans_pointer<Send_n_Bytes THEN
             IF ((ControlByte_0 XOR in_pbRxWin[0]) AND 2#0000_0001) = 0 THEN// TR = TA ?
            
                i:=1;
                WHILE (i<=SizeModule-1) AND Trans_pointer<Send_n_Bytes DO
                    in_pbTxWin[i] := Send[Trans_pointer];
                    Trans_pointer:=Trans_pointer+1;
                    i:=i+1;
                END_WHILE;    
                          
                count:=i-1;          
                ControlByte_0:=(ControlByte_0 AND 2#1000_1111) OR SHL(IN:=(INT_TO_BYTE() AND 16#07),N:=4);
                ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 XOR 16#01;
        
                   
                // --- ERST SENDEN WENN SENDEBUFFER VOLL oder alle Daten zur Klemme transportiert wurden --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               IF USE_SENDBUFFER THEN   
                        
                    IF ((Trans_pointer>=SENDBUFFERSIZE_65x) OR ((Send_n_Bytes<SENDBUFFERSIZE_65x) AND (Trans_pointer>=Send_n_Bytes))) THEN
                        ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 OR 16#08;
                    ELSE
                       ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 AND 2#1111_0111;    
                    END_IF;
                ELSE
                    ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 OR 16#08;
                END_IF;  
                          
                in_pbTxWin[0] := ControlByte_0;
                
              
            END_IF; // TR = TA
        ELSE   
            Trans_pointer:=0;
            SendRequest:=false;
                  
        END_IF;// if sendRequest
            
           
         // --- MUSS ZEICHEN ABGEHOLT WERDEN ? ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF (( in_pbTxWin[0] XOR  in_pbRxWin[0]) AND 2#0000_0010) <> 0 THEN
    
           
            // --- ANZAHL DER ZEICHEN FESTSTELLEN --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            count := BYTE_TO_INT();// / 16#10);
            // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            FOR i := 1 TO count DO
                   Receive[Receive_next_byte] := in_pbRxWin[i];
                   Receive_next_byte := (Receive_next_byte + 1) MOD SizeReceiveDB;                    
             END_FOR;
             in_pbTxWin[0]:=in_pbTxWin[0] XOR 16#02;// Daten quittieren
        END_IF;
        
    ELSE    
    // *****************************hier Modul 750-652**************************************************************
        
        ControlByte_0 := aOutput[0];
        ControlByte_1 := aOutput[1];
        
        // --- MUSS ZEICHEN GESENDET WERDEN ? ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF SendRequest AND Trans_pointer<Send_n_Bytes THEN
            IF ((ControlByte_0 XOR in_pbRxWin[0]) AND 2#0000_0001) = 0 THEN// TR = TA ?
              
                i:=2;
                WHILE (i<=SizeModule-1) AND Trans_pointer<Send_n_Bytes DO
                    in_pbTxWin[i] := Send[Trans_pointer];
                    Trans_pointer:=Trans_pointer+1;
                    i:=i+1;
                END_WHILE;    
                          
                count:=i-2;          
                ControlByte_1:=(ControlByte_1 AND 2#0000_0000 )OR (INT_TO_BYTE()AND 16#07);
                ControlByte_0:=(ControlByte_0 AND 2#1000_1111) OR SHL(IN:=(INT_TO_BYTE() AND 16#07),N:=4);
                ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 XOR 16#01;
        
                   
                // --- ERST SENDEN WENN SENDEBUFFER VOLL oder alle Daten zur Klemme transportiert wurden --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
               IF USE_SENDBUFFER THEN   
                        
                    IF ((Trans_pointer>=SENDBUFFERSIZE_652) OR ((Send_n_Bytes<SENDBUFFERSIZE_652) AND (Trans_pointer>=Send_n_Bytes))) THEN
                        ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 OR 16#08;
                    ELSE
                       ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 AND 2#1111_0111;    
                    END_IF;
                ELSE
                    ControlByte_0:=ControlByte_0 OR 16#08;
                END_IF;  
                          
                in_pbTxWin[1] := ControlByte_1;
                in_pbTxWin[0] := ControlByte_0;
                
              
            END_IF; // TR = TA
        ELSE   
            Trans_pointer:=0;
            SendRequest:=false;
                  
        END_IF;// if sendRequest
            
           
         // --- MUSS ZEICHEN ABGEHOLT WERDEN ? ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        IF (( ControlByte_0 XOR  in_pbRxWin[0]) AND 2#0000_0010) <> 0 THEN
 
            // --- ANZAHL DER ZEICHEN FESTSTELLEN --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            count := (BYTE_TO_INT() / 16#008) + (BYTE_TO_INT() * 16#08);
            // -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            FOR i := 1 TO count DO
                 Receive[Receive_next_byte] := in_pbRxWin[1];
                   Receive_next_byte := (Receive_next_byte + 1) MOD SizeReceiveDB;                    
             END_FOR;
             in_pbTxWin[0]:=in_pbTxWin[0] XOR 16#02;// Daten quittieren
         END_IF;
    END_IF;// Module 750-652
  
END_IF; // Reset



 // Daten ausgeben
IF UsedCouplerIs_303 AND SizeModule=4 THEN// Prozessabbild muss angepasst werden
    aOutput[0]:=in_pbTxWin[1];
    aOutput[1]:=in_pbTxWin[0];
    aOutput[2]:=in_pbTxWin[3];
    aOutput[3]:=in_pbTxWin[2];
ELSE
    FOR i := 0 TO SizeModule - 1 DO
        aOutput[i] := in_pbTxWin[i];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

PREH IMA AUTOMATION AMBERG GMBH    

purpose:
========
This funktion block controls a cylinder with only one sensor in home Position (A).
The position control for turn on is realized by timer.

The Communication between SPS and HMI is made by a cylinder structur.
This structur have to be linked on the HMI screen block.

All Errors are built local in this block.

The manual activation can also executed by the F-button on the mobile panel. 


additional information:
bit assignment data word

0 = activation reset (move to home position)
1 = activation set (move to work position)

2 = A sensor

7 = cylinder in position 

9  = cylinder activated
10 = error cylinder
11 = cylinder manual activated
12 = mobile panel control HP enabled
13 = mobile panel control WP enabled
14 = panel control HP enabled
15 = panel control WP enabled

purpose:
========
This function block controls a cylinder with two sensor (A,B).

The Communication between SPS and HMI is made by a cylinder structur.
This structur have to be linked on the HMI screen block.

All Errors are built local in this block.

The manual activation can also executed by the F-button on the mobile panel. 


additional information:
bit assignment data word

0 = activation reset (move to home position)
1 = activation set (move to work position)

2 = A sensor
3 = B sensor

7 = cylinder in position 

9  = cylinder activated
10 = error cylinder
11 = cylinder manual activated
12 = mobile panel control HP enabled
13 = mobile panel control WP enabled
14 = panel control HP enabled
15 = panel control WP enabled

plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/002_Marquee_ST__POU1.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project 002_Marquee_ST, read through the resident

// declarationSha256: 8e4a65a3dfac84f70f83f29198ac699842c087356a3d774ee304f6f35929e13f

PROGRAM POU1
VAR
	
	A: INT := 0;	//\u7528\u4e8e\u6267\u884c\u6b21\u6570\u7d2f\u8ba1
	b: BYTE := 1;	//\u7528\u4e8e\u79fb\u4f4d\u7684bit\u70b9\u4eae
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
//\u672c\u7a0b\u5e8f\u5229\u7528\u6bcf20ms\u6267\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u901a\u8fc7\u5bf9A++\u6765\u8fdb\u884c\u65f6\u95f4\u8ba1\u7b97\uff0c\u6bcf50\u6b21\u5373\u4e3a1\u79d2\uff0c\u8fdb\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\u79fb\u4f4d\u64cd\u4f5c
//\u53d8\u91cfb*2\u5373\u53ef\u4ee5\u8fdb\u884c\u4f4e\u4f4d\u5411\u9ad8\u4f4d\u7684\u79fb\u52a8\uff08\u5de6\u79fb\uff09,\u8be5\u53d8\u91cf\u4e0eHSIO\u8f93\u51fa\u7aef\u53e3\u5173\u8054

A:=A + 1; //\u8fdb\u5165\u8ba1\u6570
IF A>= (1000/20) THEN	
	A:=0;			//\u6bcf1000ms\uff0c\u91cd\u65b0\u5f00\u59cb\u8ba1\u6570
	b:=b*2;
	IF b=0 THEN		//\u5982\u679c\u70b9\u4eaebit\u79fb\u4f4d\u8d85\u51fa\u8303\u56f4\uff0c\u91cd\u65b0\u7f6e\u4f4d
		b:=1;
	END_IF
END_IF
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/002_Marquee_ST__POU2.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project 002_Marquee_ST, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: Device/Plc Logic/Application/POU2
// project: 002_Marquee_ST
// declarationSha256: d457112f3430022d0e57e515a4c1c98403db8c423b657176c65589a28979e867

PROGRAM POU2
VAR
	B: BYTE := 1;		//\u7528\u4e8e\u79fb\u4f4d\u7684bit\u70b9\u4eae
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
//\u672c\u7a0b\u5e8f\u5229\u7528\u6bcf1000ms\u6267\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u8fdb\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\u79fb\u4f4d\u64cd\u4f5c
//\u53d8\u91cfb/2\u5373\u53ef\u4ee5\u8fdb\u884c\u9ad8\u4f4d\u5411\u4f4e\u4f4d\u7684\u79fb\u52a8\uff08\u53f3\u79fb\uff09,,\u8be5\u53d8\u91cf\u4e0e\u6269\u5c55\u6a21\u5757DO\u8f93\u51fa\u7aef\u53e3\u5173\u8054

B :=B/2;		//\u53f3\u79fbbit\u70b9\u4eae\u4f4d
IF B=0 THEN		//\u5982\u679c\u70b9\u4eaebit\u79fb\u4f4d\u8d85\u51fa\u8303\u56f4\uff0c\u91cd\u65b0\u7f6e\u4f4d	
	B:=2#10000000;	//B:=16#80;
END_IF

PROGRAM POU2
VAR
	istep: INT := 0;
	mc_power_1: mc_power;
	p: BOOL;
	
	MC_MoveRelative_1: MC_MoveRelative;
	runf: BOOL;
	pos: LREAL;
	fb: BOOL;
	fd: BOOL;
	vol: LREAL;
	MC_Stop_1: MC_Stop;
	bStop: BOOL;
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
(* \u672c\u4f8b\u7a0b\u529f\u80fd\uff1a0\u4e0a\u7535\u540e\u81ea\u52a8\u4f7f\u80fd\u4f3a\u670d--\u300b
1\u8ba9\u4f3a\u670d\u4f4e\u901f\u6b63\u8f6c10\u5708--\u300b2\u53cd\u5411\u9ad8\u901f\u65cb\u8f6c30\u5708--\u300b1\u4f4e\u901f\u6b63\u8f6c10\u5708--\u300b2\uff08\u5faa\u73af\uff09
\u82e5bStop\u6807\u5fd7\u7f6e1\uff0c\u7acb\u5373\u505c\u6b62\uff1b\u5c06bStop\u6807\u5fd7\u6e050\uff0c\u4ece0\u5f00\u59cb
*)

CASE  istep OF
	
0:  //enable IS620N
	mc_power_1(
	Axis:= Axis_1, 
	Enable:= TRUE, 
	bRegulatorOn:=TRUE, 
	bDriveStart:= TRUE, 
	Status=> p, 
	bRegulatorRealState=> , 
	bDriveStartRealState=> , 
	Busy=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorID=> );
	
	IF p THEN
		istep:=1;
	END_IF
		
1:	//Forward run begin
	runf:=1;
	pos:=20;
	vol:=3;
	istep:=2;
	
2:	//Forward running
	IF fd THEN
		istep:=3;
	END_IF
	
3:	//Backward run begin
	runf:=1;
	pos:=-30;
	vol:=10;
		
	istep:=4;
//	
	4:	//Null loop
	IF fd THEN
		istep:=1;
	END_IF 
	
	
END_CASE


MC_MoveRelative_1(    //\u4e0a\u9762\u5bf9\u547d\u4ee4\u6807\u5fd7\u3001\u8fd0\u884c\u76ee\u6807\u4f4d\u7f6e\u3001\u901f\u5ea6\u786e\u5b9a\u540e\uff0c\u8fd9\u91cc\u7edf\u4e00\u8fdb\u884c\u8fd0\u52a8\u63a7\u5236
	Axis:= Axis_1, 
	Execute:= runf, 
	Distance:= pos, 
	Velocity:= vol, 
	Acceleration:= 50, 
	Deceleration:=50 , 
	Jerk:= , 
	Done=> fd, 
	Busy=> fb, 
	CommandAborted=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorID=> );
	

IF fb THEN  	//\u672cMC\u6a21\u5757\u8fd0\u884c\u5f00\u59cb\u540e\uff0c\u5373\u6e05\u9664\u8fd0\u884c\u89e6\u53d1\u53d8\u91cf\uff0c\u4fbf\u4e8e\u53ca\u65f6\u4ea7\u751f\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
	runf:=0;
END_IF

MC_Stop_1( 		//\u505c\u673a\u547d\u4ee4\u5904\u7406
	Axis:= Axis_1, 
	Execute:= bStop, 
	Deceleration:= 100, 
	Jerk:= , 
	Done=> , 
	Busy=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorID=> );
	
	IF bStop THEN   //\u505c\u673a\u547d\u4ee4\u590d\u4f4d\u540e\uff0c\u91cd\u65b0\u5f00\u59cb\u8fd0\u884c
		istep:=0;
		
	END_IF

1\u4f3a\u670d\u8fdb\u5165\u4f4d\u7f6e\u6a21\u5f0f\uff0c\u4ee52RPM\u6b63\u8f6c5\u5708--> 2\u4f3a\u670d\u8fdb\u5165\u901f\u5ea6\u6a21\u5f0f\uff0c\u4ee55RPM\u7684\u901f\u5ea6\u8fd0\u884c4\u79d2\u949f\uff1b
--> 3\u4f3a\u670d\u8fdb\u5165\u529b\u77e9\u6a21\u5f0f\uff0c\u4ee5\u8bbe\u5b9a\u529b\u77e9\u8fd0\u884c2\u79d2\u949f\uff1b--> 1\uff08\u5faa\u73af\uff09

\u6ce8\u610f\uff1a\u529b\u77e9\u6a21\u5f0f\u8fd0\u884c\u8981\u6709\u8bbe\u5b9a\u529b\u77e9\uff0c\u5141\u8bb8\u6700\u5927\u8f6e\u5ed3\u901f\u5ea6\u9650\u5236\uff0c\u9632\u6b62\u610f\u5916\u9ad8\u901f\u65cb\u8f6c\u3002

*)

CASE istep OF
	
0:
MC_Power_1(  //\u4e0a\u7535\u540e\u4f3a\u670d\u4f7f\u80fd
	Axis:= Axis_1, 
	Enable:= TRUE,
	bRegulatorOn:= TRUE, 
	bDriveStart:= TRUE, 
	Status=> p, 
	bRegulatorRealState=> , 
	bDriveStartRealState=> , 
	Busy=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorID=> );

	IF p THEN
	istep:=1;  //\u4f3a\u670d\u4f7f\u80fd\u5b8c\u6210\u540e\uff0c\u624d\u8fdb\u5165\u72b6\u60011
	END_IF

1://Positon Mode
	SMC_SetControllerMode_1(
	Axis:= Axis_1, 
	bExecute:= p, 
	nControllerMode:= 3, //\u5207\u6362\u4e3a\u201c\u4f4d\u7f6e\u6a21\u5f0f\u201d
	bDone=> PM, 
	bBusy=> , 
	bError=> , 
	nErrorID=> );	
	
		MC_MoveRelative_1(    //\u4ee52RPM\u6b63\u8f6c5\u5708
		Axis:= Axis_1, 
		Execute:= PM, 
		Distance:= 5, 
		Velocity:= 2, 
		Acceleration:= 10, 
		Deceleration:= 10, 
		Jerk:= , 
		Done=> P1, 
		Busy=> , 
		CommandAborted=> , 
		Error=> , 
		ErrorID=> );
	
	IF P1 THEN
		istep:=2;    //\u82e5\u8fd0\u52a8\u5b8c\u6210\uff0c\u8df3\u8f6c\u5230\u72b6\u60012
		
		MC_MoveRelative_1( //\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
		Axis:= Axis_1, 
		Execute:= FALSE);
		
		SMC_SetControllerMode_1(  //\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
		Axis:= Axis_1, 
		bExecute:= FALSE);
		
		tmr:=0;   //\u4e3a\u4e0b\u4e00\u4e2a\u72b6\u6001\u4e2d\u7528\u7684\u8ba1\u65f6\u5668\u590d\u4f4d
	END_IF

	
2:// Speed Mode
	SMC_SetControllerMode_Speed(
		Axis:= Axis_1, 
		bExecute:= p, 
		nControllerMode:= 2, //\u5207\u6362\u4e3a\u201c\u901f\u5ea6\u6a21\u5f0f\u201d
		bDone=> SM, 
		bBusy=> , 
		bError=> , 
		nErrorID=> );	
		
		IF SM THEN//\u901f\u5ea6\u6a21\u5f0f\u5207\u6362\u6210\u529f\u540e\uff0c\u624d\u5f00\u59cb\u901f\u5ea6\u6307\u4ee4\u7684\u8fd0\u884c
			MC_MoveVelocity_1(
			Axis:= Axis_1, 
			Execute:= sm, 
			Velocity:= 5, //\u4ee55RPM\u7684\u901f\u5ea6\u8fd0\u884c
			Acceleration:= 20, 
			Deceleration:= 20, 
			Jerk:= , 
			Direction:= , 
			InVelocity=> , 
			Busy=> , 
			CommandAborted=> , 
			Error=> , 
			ErrorID=> );
			bAxis_con:=TRUE;
			tmr:=tmr+1;
		END_IF
		
		 IF tmr>1000 THEN	//\u8fd0\u8f6c\u4e864ms*1000=4S\u540e
			MC_MoveVelocity_1(
			Axis:= Axis_1, 
			Execute:= FALSE) ; 	 //\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
		END_IF
		
		MC_Stop_Speed(
			Axis:= Axis_1, 
			Execute:= (tmr>1000), //\u8fd0\u8f6c\u4e864ms*1000=4S\u540e\uff0c\u5148\u4f3a\u670d\u505c\u673a
			Deceleration:=1000 , 
			Jerk:= , 
			Done=> , 
			Busy=> , 
			Error=> , 
			ErrorID=> );
			
	IF 	MC_Stop_Speed.Done THEN //\u4f3a\u670d\u505c\u673a\u540e\uff0c
			MC_Stop_Speed(
			Axis:=Axis_1 , 
			Execute:= FALSE);//\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
	END_IF
	
		IF  bAxis_con AND Axis_1.nAxisState =3 THEN//\u901f\u5ea6\u6a21\u5f0f\u65f6\u53ea\u6709\u5728\u505c\u6b62\u72b6\u6001\uff08standstill\uff09\u4e0b\uff0c\u624d\u80fd\u5f80\u4e0b\u4e00\u6b65\u8f6c
			istep:=3;
			tmr:=0;		
			bAxis_con:=FALSE;
			
			SMC_SetControllerMode_Speed(
				Axis:= Axis_1, 
				bExecute:= FALSE);//\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
		END_IF

3://Torque Mode
	SMC_SetControllerMode_Torque(
		Axis:= Axis_1, 
		bExecute:= p, 
		nControllerMode:= 1,  //\u5207\u6362\u4e3a\u201c\u529b\u77e9\u6a21\u5f0f\u201d
		bDone=> TM, 
		bBusy=> , 
		bError=> , 
		nErrorID=> );	
		
	IF TM THEN//\u529b\u77e9\u6a21\u5f0f\u5207\u6362\u6210\u529f\u540e\uff0c\u8bbe\u7f6e\u8fd0\u884c\u529b\u77e9
		SMC_SetTorque_1(
		Axis:=Axis_1 , 
		bEnable:=TRUE , 
		fTorque:= Torque_Val, //\u8bbe\u7f6e\u8d1f\u7684\u529b\u77e9\uff0c\u53ef\u4f7f\u5176\u53cd\u8f6c\u8fd0\u884c
		bBusy=> , 
		bError=> , 
		nErrorID=> );		
	END_IF	
	
		 tmr:=tmr+1;	
		 IF (tmr>500) THEN	//\u8fd0\u8f6c\u4e864ms*5000=2S\u540e
			 istep:=1;
			 tmr:=0;
			 
			SMC_SetTorque_1(
				Axis:=Axis_1 , 
				bEnable:=FALSE );	//\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf	 
		
			SMC_SetControllerMode_Torque(
				Axis:= Axis_1, 
				bExecute:= FALSE);	 //\u518d\u8fd0\u884c\u4e00\u6b21\uff0c\u662f\u4e3a\u4e86\u8ba9\u4e0b\u6b21\u8be5\u6307\u4ee4\u6267\u884c\u80fd\u6709\u4e00\u4e2a\u89e6\u53d1\u4e0a\u5347\u6cbf
		
		 END_IF
	
END_CASE
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/005_MarqueeAndServoMotion__POU1.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project 005_MarqueeAndServoMotion, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: Device/Plc Logic/Application/POU1
// project: 005_MarqueeAndServoMotion
// declarationSha256: 34b5fed3b4e18e8c7e6b6d18a5ea6b63c0c42f476235d6097c234ed4ecd13505

PROGRAM POU1
VAR
	
	A: INT := 0;
	b: BYTE := 1;
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
A:=A + 1; //\u8fdb\u5165\u8ba1\u6570
IF A> (1000/20) THEN
	A:=0;
	b:=b*2;
	IF b=0 THEN
		b:=1;
	END_IF
END_IF
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/005_MarqueeAndServoMotion__POU2.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project 005_MarqueeAndServoMotion, read through the resident

PROGRAM POU2
VAR
	B: BYTE := 1;
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
B :=B/2;
IF B=0 THEN
	//B:=16#80;:
	b:=2#10000000;
END_IF

//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.

// declarationSha256: e33e1147ad5ddb2895a2efb7adc50dd1deb3cde437a41122e79469adb42d3afb

PROGRAM POU3_ETC
VAR
	a:BOOL;		//\u4f7f\u80fd\u4f3a\u670d
	JOG:BOOL;	//\u70b9\u52a8\u4f3a\u670d
	Runf: BOOL;	//\u8ba9\u4f3a\u670d\u8fd0\u884c10\u5708
	
	MC_Power_1:MC_Power;
	MC_Jog_1: MC_jog;
	MC_MoveRelative_1: MC_MoveRelative;
	movr: BOOL;
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
MC_Power_1(
	Axis:=Axis_1 , 
	Enable:=TRUE , 
	bRegulatorOn:= a, //\u5c06a\u7f6e\u4e3atrue\uff0c\u53ef\u4ee5\u5c06\u4f3a\u670d\u4f7f\u80fd
	bDriveStart:= TRUE, 
	Status=> , 
	bRegulatorRealState=> , 
	bDriveStartRealState=> , 
	Busy=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorID=> );
	
MC_Jog_1(
	Axis:= Axis_1, 
	JogForward:= jog, //\u4f3a\u670d\u4f7f\u80fd\u540e\uff0c\u5c06jog\u7f6e\u4e3ature\uff0c\u53ef\u4ee5\u8ba9\u4f3a\u670d\u4ee5\u6bcf\u79d21\u5708\u7684\u901f\u5ea6\u70b9\u52a8\u8fd0\u884c
	JogBackward:= , 
	Velocity:= 1, 
	Acceleration:= 10, 
	Deceleration:= 10, 
	Jerk:= , 
	Busy=> , 
	CommandAborted=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorId=> );
	
MC_MoveRelative_1(
	Axis:=  Axis_1, 
	Execute:= Runf, 
	Distance:= 10,	//\u65cb\u8f6c10\u5708 
	Velocity:= 2, 
	Acceleration:= 10, 
	Deceleration:= 10, 
	Jerk:= , 
	Done=> , 
	Busy=> movr, 
	CommandAborted=> , 
	Error=> , 
	ErrorID=> );
	
	IF movr THEN	//\u6bcf\u6b21Runf\u7f6e\u4f4d\uff0c\u8fd0\u884c\u540e\u81ea\u52a8\u6e05\u96f6
		Runf:=0;
	END_IF

plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/CNC_File__CNC.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project CNC_File, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: CoDeSys_SoftMotion_Win_V3/Plc Logic/Application/CNC
// project: CNC_File
// declarationSha256: c3486042c75b87a2cf6de5b2d4a82e8dfe3112ac5c688a73919c2336e8ae239b

PROGRAM CNC
VAR
	iState: INT;
	pX, pY, pZ: MC_Power;

	ipo: SMC_Interpolator;
	trafo: SMC_TRAFO_Gantry3;
	trafof: SMC_TRAFOF_Gantry3D;
	cabpX, 	cabpY, 	cabpZ: SMC_ControlAxisByPos;
	
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
pX(
	Enable:=TRUE , 
	bRegulatorOn:=TRUE , 
	bDriveStart:=TRUE , 
	Axis:=AxisX);
pY(
	Enable:=TRUE , 
	bRegulatorOn:=TRUE , 
	bDriveStart:=TRUE , 
	Axis:=AxisY);
pZ(
	Enable:=TRUE , 
	bRegulatorOn:=TRUE , 
	bDriveStart:=TRUE , 
	Axis:=AxisZ);

CASE iState OF
0:
	IF pX.Status AND pY.Status AND pZ.Status THEN
		iState:=100;
	END_IF
100:
	Interpolation();
END_CASE
plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/CNC_File__CNC_PreparePath.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project CNC_File, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: CoDeSys_SoftMotion_Win_V3/Plc Logic/Application/CNC_PreparePath
// project: CNC_File
// declarationSha256: cd58db54c29026c6e9d74e07f95acc8a1b3509fc3ce06185954358ebb600fbd3

PROGRAM CNC_PreparePath
VAR_INPUT
	xStart: BOOL;
	sFileName: STRING := '_cnc/CNC1.cnc';
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	xStartIpo: BOOL;
	poqPath: Pointer to SMC_Outqueue;
END_VAR
VAR
	iState: INT;
	rncf : SMC_ReadNCFile;
	ncd: SMC_NCDecoder;
	cv: SMC_CheckVelocities;
	agcwBufReadNCFile: ARRAY[0..99] OF SMC_GCODE_WORD;
	agiBufDecoder: ARRAY[0..99] OF SMC_GeoInfo;
	
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
poqPath:=cv.poqDataOut;

CASE iState OF
0:	// idle
	IF xStart THEN
		iState:=10;
		xStartIpo := FALSE;
		rncf(bExecute:=FALSE); 
		ncd(bExecute:=FALSE, ncprog:=rncf.ncprog); 
		cv(bExecute:=FALSE);
		xStart:=FALSE;
	END_IF
10:	// start reading and processing 
	rncf(
		bExecute:=TRUE , 
		sFileName:=sFilename , 
		pvl:= , 
		pBuffer:=ADR(agcwBufReadNCFile) , 
		dwBufferSize:=SIZEOF(agcwBufReadNCFile) , 
		fDefaultVel:= , 
		fDefaultAccel:= , 
		fDefaultDecel:= , 
		bDone=> , 
		bBusy=> , 
		bError=> , 
		ErrorID=> , 
		bExecuteDecoder=> , 
		ncprog=> );
	ncd(
		bExecute:=rncf.bExecuteDecoder , 
		bAppend:= , 
		bStepSuppress:= , 
		piStartPosition:= , 
		nSizeOutQueue:=SIZEOF(agiBufDecoder) , 
		pbyBufferOutQueue:=ADR(agiBufDecoder) , 
		ncprog:=rncf.ncprog , 
		bDone=> , 
		bBusy=> , 
		bError=> , 
		wErrorID=> , 
		poqDataOut=> , 
		iStatus=> , 
		iLineNumberDecoded=> , 
		GCodeText=> );
	cv(
		bExecute:=rncf.bExecuteDecoder ,
		poqDataIn:=ncd.poqDataOut , 
		dAngleTol:= , 
		bBusy=> , 
		bError=> , 
		wErrorID=> , 
		poqDataOut=> );
		
	xStartIpo := rncf.bExecuteDecoder;
	IF NOT cv.bBusy THEN
		iState:=0;
	END_IF
END_CASE

plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/PLCopenMultiCAM__MOTION_PRG.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project PLCopenMultiCAM, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: CoDeSys_SoftMotion_Win_V3/Plc Logic/Application/MOTION_PRG
// project: PLCopenMultiCAM
// declarationSha256: a318ffa3b3eca1c31dfef903b4901c00c81f5d96b47461297b907331ab4023d6

PROGRAM MOTION_PRG
VAR
	Init: BOOL := FALSE;
	Power, PowerVirtual: MC_Power;
	MoveVirtual: MC_MoveVelocity := (Execute:=true, Velocity:=1, Acceleration:=100, Deceleration:=100);
	TableSelect1, TableSelect2: MC_CamTableSelect;
	CamIn: MC_CamIn;
	Tappet: SMC_GetTappetValue;
	byCAM:BYTE:=1;
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
IF NOT Init THEN
	Power(Enable:=TRUE, bRegulatorOn:=TRUE, bDriveStart:=TRUE, Axis:=Drive);
	PowerVirtual(Enable:=TRUE, bRegulatorOn:=TRUE, bDriveStart:=TRUE, Axis:=Virtual);
	Init:= Power.Status;
	TableSelect1(Execute:=TRUE, Periodic:=TRUE,Master:=Virtual, Slave:=Drive, CamTable:=Example1);
	TableSelect2(Execute:=TRUE, Periodic:=TRUE,Master:=Virtual, Slave:=Drive, CamTable:=Example2);
	CamIn.CamTableID := TableSelect1.CamTableID;
ELSE
	MoveVirtual(Axis:=Virtual);
	IF CamIn.EndOfProfile THEN
		IF byCAM = 1 THEN
			CamIn.CamTableID := TableSelect2.CamTableID;
			byCAM := 2;
		ELSE
			CamIn.CamTableID := TableSelect1.CamTableID;
			byCAM := 1;
		END_IF
		CamIn(Execute:=FALSE, Master:=Virtual, Slave:=Drive);
	END_IF
	CamIn(Execute:=TRUE, StartMode:=ramp_in, VelocityDiff:=10, Acceleration:=100, Deceleration:=100, Master:=Virtual, Slave:=Drive);
	Tappet(Tappets:=CamIn.Tappets, iID:=1);
END_IF

plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/PLCopenSingle2__MOTION_PRG.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project PLCopenSingle2, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: CoDeSys_SoftMotion_Win_V3/Plc Logic/Application/MOTION_PRG
// project: PLCopenSingle2
// declarationSha256: 8e154b86180b6b11b7f1bf2970bf4fec75076f0797534125eb286d34ec4cd328

PROGRAM MOTION_PRG

plc-study-library/ç‰‡æ®µ/11_CODESYS_STçœŸå®žå·¥ç¨‹/PLCopenSingle__MOTION_PRG.st// source: real CODESYS-kernel project PLCopenSingle, read through the resident
//         InoProShop bridge (source.snapshot) on 2026-09-09.
// source: CoDeSys_SoftMotion_Win_V3/Plc Logic/Application/MOTION_PRG
// project: PLCopenSingle
// declarationSha256: 5d8bb08a65423e756748c96ceb5fdee81814f855bc99b303df0f785edd7fc2c3

PROGRAM MOTION_PRG
VAR
	iStatus: INT;
	Power: MC_Power;
	MoveAbsolute: MC_MoveAbsolute;
	p:REAL:=100;
END_VAR

// ---- implementation ----
CASE iStatus OF
0:
	Power(Enable:=TRUE, bRegulatorOn:=TRUE, bDriveStart:=TRUE, Axis:=Drive);
	IF Power.Status THEN
		iStatus := iStatus + 1;
	END_IF
1:
	MoveAbsolute(Execute:=TRUE, Position:= p, Velocity:=100, Acceleration:=100, Deceleration:=100, Axis:=Drive);
	IF MoveAbsolute.Done THEN
		MoveAbsolute(Execute:=FALSE, Axis:=Drive);
		iStatus := iStatus + 1;
	END_IF
2:
	MoveAbsolute(Execute:=TRUE, Position:= 0, Velocity:=100, Acceleration:=100, Deceleration:=100, Axis:=Drive);
	IF MoveAbsolute.Done THEN
		MoveAbsolute(Execute:=FALSE, Axis:=Drive);
		iStatus := 1;
	END_IF
END_CASE

   END_VAR
   VAR_OUTPUT

      Valid : Bool;          // BCDåˆæ³•ä¸”æ— æ•…éšœ, PulseCountå¯ç”¨

   END_VAR
   VAR
      statResetEdge : R_TRIG;   // å¤ä½ä¿¡å·ä¸Šå‡æ²¿ (å¿…é¡»æ”¾é™æ€åŒº, è·¨æ‰«æå‘¨æœŸä¿æŒ)
      statFaultLatch : Bool;    // æ•…éšœé”å­˜ä½

      tempD0 : Int;             // ä¸ªä½ BCD

   #tempBcdOk := (#tempD0 <= 9) AND (#tempD1 <= 9) AND (#tempD2 <= 9) AND (#tempD3 <= 9);

FUNCTION_BLOCK "FB_PWM_Generator"
{ S7_Optimized_Access := 'TRUE' }
VERSION : 0.1
VAR_INPUT

   FreqSetpoint : Real;        // é¢‘çŽ‡è®¾å®šå€¼ [Hz], æœ‰æ•ˆèŒƒå›´ 0.01 .. 100.0
   DutyCycle : Real;           // å ç©ºæ¯” [%], æœ‰æ•ˆèŒƒå›´ 0 .. 100
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
   PwmOut : Bool;              // PWM æ–¹æ³¢è¾“å‡º
   PeriodMs : Real;            // å®žé™…å‘¨æœŸ [ms], ä¾› HMI ç›‘è§†
   HighTimeMs : Real;          // å®žé™…é«˜ç”µå¹³æ—¶é—´ [ms], ä¾› HMI ç›‘è§†
   ParamError : Bool;          // å‚æ•°è¶Šé™æˆ–éžæ³•
   ErrorCode : Int;            // 0=æ­£å¸¸ 1=é¢‘çŽ‡ä½ŽäºŽä¸‹é™ 2=é¢‘çŽ‡é«˜äºŽä¸Šé™ 3=å ç©ºæ¯”ä½ŽäºŽä¸‹é™ 4=å ç©ºæ¯”é«˜äºŽä¸Šé™ 5=å‚æ•°ä¸ºNaN

   statHighMs : Real;          // é«˜ç”µå¹³æ—¶é—´ [ms]
   statT_High : Time;          // é«˜ç”µå¹³ç›¸å®šæ—¶å™¨è®¾å®šå€¼
   statT_Low : Time;           // ä½Žç”µå¹³ç›¸å®šæ—¶å™¨è®¾å®šå€¼
   tonHigh : TON_TIME;         // é«˜ç”µå¹³ç›¸å®šæ—¶å™¨

BEGIN

   // é¢‘çŽ‡/å ç©ºæ¯”æ¥è‡ª HMI æˆ–ä¸Šä½æœº, å¿…é¡»åœ¨å—å†…åšé™å¹…, é¿å…é™¤é›¶ä¸Žè¶…èŒƒå›´è¾“å‡º
   #ParamError := FALSE;
   #ErrorCode := 0;

   #statFreq := #FreqSetpoint;
   IF #statFreq <> #statFreq THEN          // NaN æ£€æŸ¥(è‡ªæ¯”è¾ƒä¸ºçœŸå³ä¸º NaN)
      #statFreq := 1.0;
      #ParamError := TRUE;
      #ErrorCode := 5;
   ELSIF #statFreq < 0.01 THEN
      #statFreq := 0.01;
      #ParamError := TRUE;
      #ErrorCode := 1;
   ELSIF #statFreq > 100.0 THEN
      #statFreq := 100.0;

   END_IF;

   #statDuty := #DutyCycle;

      #ParamError := TRUE;
      #ErrorCode := 5;
   ELSIF #statDuty < 0.0 THEN

   ELSIF #statDuty > 100.0 THEN
      #statDuty := 100.0;

   END_IF;

   // ================= 2. è®¡ç®—å‘¨æœŸä¸Žé«˜ä½Žç”µå¹³æ—¶é—´ =================
   // å‘¨æœŸ = 1/é¢‘çŽ‡; é»˜è®¤é¢‘çŽ‡ 1.0 Hz æ—¶å‘¨æœŸä¸º 1000 ms (å³ 1 ç§’æ–¹æ³¢)
   #statPeriodMs := 1000.0 / #statFreq;                    // å‘¨æœŸ [ms]
   #statHighMs := #statPeriodMs * #statDuty / 100.0;       // é«˜ç”µå¹³æ—¶é—´ [ms]

   #statT_High := DINT_TO_TIME(ROUND(#statHighMs));        // Real(ms) -> DInt(ms) -> Time

   IF NOT #Enable THEN

      #statPhase := 0;

      #PwmOut := FALSE;
   ELSIF #statDuty <= 0.0 THEN
      // å ç©ºæ¯” 0%: æ’ä½Žç”µå¹³
      #statPhase := 0;

   ELSIF #statDuty >= 100.0 THEN

      #statPhase := 0;

      CASE #statPhase OF

            IF #tonHigh.Q THEN

            END_IF;
         1:   // ---- ä½Žç”µå¹³ç›¸ ----
            #tonHigh(IN := FALSE, PT := #statT_High);
            #tonLow(IN := TRUE, PT := #statT_Low);
            #PwmOut := FALSE;
            IF #tonLow.Q THEN

               #tonLow(IN := FALSE, PT := #statT_Low);         // å¤ä½ä½Žç”µå¹³å®šæ—¶å™¨
            END_IF;
      ELSE
